meta.description: TR-11, Blueprint §10 flow 2. Daily 17:30: GET checkins/pending-reminders (no `date` -> defaults to TODAY server-side, in REPORTS_TZ) direct-to-platform under wf:reports-eod-reminder (company_admin). §5.3's false-negative guard means this list is ALREADY filtered by construction -- a holiday/leave day returns `pending: []` and this flow delivers NOTHING (asserted by platform-nest's own checkins.controller tests). For each pending person WITH a verified WA link (`hasWaLink` + the additive `waExternalId` field): the BOT's `/admin/notify` fetches their OWN prefill (as their OWN OBO envelope, D4) and remembers the pending reply -- see wa-chat-bot/src/checkin.ts. For each pending person WITHOUT one: an in-app notification via the hub's `notify` tool (Blueprint §10: 'others: in-app notification'). Idempotent/re-drivable: composeCheckinReminder on the bot side no-ops (sent:false) if the day is already submitted by the time this re-drives, and the platform read itself has no side effects. Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, BOT_URL, BOT_ADMIN_TOKEN, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: "checkin_reminder", payload: { date: $json.date } } } }) }}
